verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's pricing page lists a 'Candidate Eligibility Evaluation' as included, and its O-1A page says the team maps your accomplishments to the USCIS criteria before preparing the case. That is a first-party pre-filing assessment, but the evidence never describes how the evaluation is structured or how each criterion is weighed. The EB-1A self-assessment quiz covers a different visa and does not count here. Missing for 10: a documented structured O-1A assessment methodology or deliverable, a per-criterion evaluation description, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed

citations.quote: Our team will work with you to map your accomplishments to the USCIS criteria to ensure a clear understanding of how to prepare a strong case
